Completed all TODOs in character_agent.py for chapter 5 A2A integration:
1. Added create_character, find_character_by_name, and list_all_characters tools to the agent
2. Set agent name to "Character Agent"
3. Set agent description to "D&D character management: creates characters (ability scores rolled 4d6 drop lowest), stores them, finds and lists them."
4. Created A2AServer with create_agent factory on port 8001
5. Added server startup code with proper error handling
